searchText: Great Thanks. I totally missed that withdrawals are also visible on execution payload of beacon block body. I will just fetch the block body : eth/v2/beacon/blocks/finalized and get the execution_payload.withdrawals. The last index+1 would be the `next_withdrawal_validator_index` For an estimate of the next withdrawal you also need to know which validators are eligible for withdrawal, hence requiring the validators state as well. That is true. However, the estimate error by considering all are withdrawables, would be just a few slots, I dont expect 100s of unwithdrawable validators having subsequent indexes. Current validator statuses: ``` Validator states: Pending: 371 Activating: 498 Active: 1077451 Exiting: 768 Exited: 583831 ``` So it is likely that at least 1/3 of the validator indices aren't eligible for withdrawal. Up to you as to if you are okay with that level of imprecision.
